decision: Carry only exact bare field reads selected by each typed function into an immutable field-read catalog
reason: Lua needs the field chosen by the typer, not every class declaration or a target-owned reconstruction
result: Each function owns only the NameRead field facts it actually consumes

decision: Keep TyFieldInfo as the semantic authority and use projected names only as temporary body transport
reason: A bare Haxe name cannot prove owner, staticness, type, or declaration properties
result: Conflicting owner/type/declaration facts for one transport name fail before rendering

decision: Reserve exact bare-field transport names before deterministic local-name allocation
reason: A local named value and a static field named value must remain distinct after the temporary source-shaped projection

decision: Resolve Lua identifier receivers as exact local first, then exact static field

decision: Delete both Lua static-field process maps and their save, restore, reset, and audit lifecycle

decision: Prove same-function shadowing, helper isolation, conflict rejection, repeatability, failure cleanup, and runtime behavior

result: Direct, repeated, failed, and post-failure output agree; Lua runtime output is FIELD, 7, field, FIELD
